# Capture intake — `workflow todo [idea]`

Read the relevant TODO entries and record the user's idea in the existing style. Merge an obvious
duplicate rather than adding another copy; check ambiguous overlap before changing its meaning.
A clear request to capture an idea authorizes the entry without a separate approval round.

Ask only for missing information necessary to represent the idea faithfully. Keep small changes
small. Scope, motivation, and a simple completion criterion are enough for a larger item; do not
turn intake into a spec. Point to an existing roadmap or product decision instead of duplicating
it. Keep conflicts visible without silently changing settled direction.

Show the entry and its location. Capture does not start implementation or alter active run state.
